title: Character bible
description: bibles/characters.json: one identity string per character, copied verbatim into every card and prompt, plus wardrobe by scene.

pronounce.description: How names and invented words are said: the word as written -> the spelling the voice model reads. Used inside spoken lines only; the name stays as written everywhere else.

identity.description: Age, build, face, hair, one distinctive mark. No wardrobe.

wardrobe.description: default plus optional overrides keyed by scene id.

refs.description: Turnaround sheet or reference image ids. A list goes to every card. For a costume or wound stage, an object keyed like wardrobe: default plus scene ids or stage names (e.g. {"default": [...], "1b": [...], "L1": [...]}); a card's cast entry picks a stage with refs_stage, else its scene id, else default.
